BBTTCC Heritage (v1.1, RFI-native). Menhirkin heritage: Metamorphic.

“What you are now is not what you were. The pressure was the point.”

Menhirkin (Metamorphic). You are land that was buried, squeezed, heated, and came back up harder and more interesting. Every Metamorphic has a before-self — a softer version of themselves that got pressed into something else. You remember being that. You are not going back.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Menhirkin).
  • Size. Medium.
  • Movement. 30 feet walking.
  • Lineage Lean. Menhirkin does not grant fixed attribute bonuses; your background handles increases. Your heritage leans toward Body in fiction and through Tier powers.

Menhirkin Core: The Land Stood Up

Shared across all Menhirkin heritages. Granted at character creation via the base ancestry item.

  • Stone Soul. You count as Large for carry, shove, and grapple despite your Medium frame. You have advantage on checks to resist being forcibly moved.
  • Hex Recognition. Once per scene, while you are on a natural surface you are directly touching, you may whisper a single question about the place. The GM answers with one true thing the land knows.
  • Slow to Wear. You have advantage on Body checks against exhaustion, long-duration physical wear, forced marches, climate exposure, and sustained labor. You do not tire the way softer things tire.
  • Heavy Presence. Your weight and settledness are perceptible. Creatures within 10 feet of you know you are there even if they cannot see you; you have disadvantage on Intrigue (Stealth) checks unless you are on or in stone.

Metamorphic Traits

  • Pressure Remade. At the end of each Soma Break, the day chooses what you are until your next Soma Break. Roll a d4 or pick (GM discretion): (1) +1 Guard, (2) resistance to kinetic damage, (3) +1 rank on one skill of your choice, (4) advantage on Body checks to resist being knocked prone or grappled. You announce the result; you do not pre-pick.
  • Unbreakable Core. You have advantage on defense checks against petrification, forced transmutation, and forced shape-change. You have been turned into something else once already; nobody does it twice without your say-so.

Strategic Hooks (Foundry / BBTTCC)

  • OP Edge. Your faction gains +2 Non-Lethal OP and +1 Intrigue OP at campaign start.
  • Hex Synergy. In Any hex your faction has held for 3+ Strategic Turns hexes, your faction gains +1 on defense checks in that hex.
  • Second-Form Bearing. Once per Strategic Turn, your faction may treat one Morale or Loyalty check as if it had one additional track-band of headroom. The thing you became has held under pressure before.
⟁ Per-Use Ability — Hex Recognition
Recovery: 1/scene  ·  Action: Action  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke.
